text:
```yaml
name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: number

jobs:
  update-nuget-package-lock-json:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up .NET Core
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Restore solution with force evaluate
        run: dotnet restore SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln --force-evaluate

      - name: Commit changes if any
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update NuGet package lock json" || true

      - name: Push changes to PR branch
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:$GITHUB_REF
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Trigger Renovate PR update
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ github.event.inputs.prNumber }}/reviews \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"event": "COMMENT"}'
```
